note: The supported compose shapes (docs/META_REPO.md §2). Every one is rendered and asserted by the `validate` lane. `floor` is a DECISION, not a count of whatever rows survive: scripts/compose-render.py refuses to run when the declared ids do not match the shapes below, so deleting a shape is a visible edit rather than a quietly smaller matrix. This is the same rule .github/required-checks.txt has for lanes, for the same reason.

ci_overrides._note: Shell environment beats --env-file in Compose, so these fill exactly the values the template ships BLANK. They are obviously fake and are on both components' refused-value lists in spirit: nothing here is a value a host should ever run. Secret values are redacted out of every rendered model before it is written or uploaded.

external_dsn_overrides._note: Deliberately CREDENTIAL-FREE. These only have to satisfy scripts/compose-render.py's DSN validator (scheme + host), and a `user:password@host` placeholder is a credential-shaped string in a tracked file - a secret scanner is right to flag one, and a reviewer should not have to decide whether it is real. `.invalid` is reserved by RFC 2606 and resolves nowhere.

secret_keys_note: The authoritative answer to 'which injected values must NEVER appear in a written model'. Identical to redact_keys today, and deliberately a SEPARATE list rather than the same one used twice: redact_keys drives the redaction, secret_keys drives the leak check that runs on the object about to be serialised. Because the two are independent, deleting a key from redact_keys stops redacting its value and does NOT stop checking for it - so the renderer FAILS instead of writing a file that is less redacted than its own `secret_values_redacted: true` stamp claims. A key here that is not in redact_keys is therefore a guaranteed render failure, by construction. Tags and origins are NOT secrets and are absent from both lists: they belong in a rendered model.
release_image_services_note: Services whose image comes from the RELEASE RECORD (ghcr.io/<owner>/vizra-*:${VIZRA_*_TAG}). For these a non-empty, non-latest tag is enough: a release tag is what releases/<tag>.json names, and recording the resolved digest at deploy time is VZ-UPGRADE-002's job. EVERY OTHER image is third-party and must carry an @sha256 digest (ADR-001: PostgreSQL 18 'managed and digest-pinned', Valkey 9.1.x 'digest-pinned'). A service missing from this list gets the strict branch, so the safe default is the one that requires a digest.

known_false_probes_note: Probes that CANNOT GO RED while the service is broken. Declaring one here is not permission - it is a standing, printed admission. scripts/check-compose-topology.py names every entry on EVERY run, refuses any depends_on service_healthy edge onto one (rule probe-gates-readiness), and refuses an entry that matches no rendered service (rule stale-known-false-probe) so the list cannot rot. THIS LIST MUST BE EMPTY BEFORE VZ-ISSUE-004's BOOT LANE LANDS: that lane and `vizra deploy` are both written against `--wait` / `ps --status healthy`, and a green that cannot go red is how a false gate becomes permanent. What empties it: a `vizra healthcheck` subcommand in vizra-core, mirroring the one vizra-search already ships (queue 2h). The /dev/tcp shell bridge was considered and REJECTED by the chair - it would bake a bash dependency into a runtime image a queued core slice rebuilds from a clean base.

known_false_probes.why_false: a CLI that prints build info and exits 0 without opening a socket or touching PostgreSQL. An api wedged with PostgreSQL unreachable, or listening but deadlocked, still reports healthy.
known_false_probes.real_probe_exists: vizra-core serves /healthz (liveness) and /readyz (503 only on PostgreSQL, otherwise 200 `degraded` with the component named). The image carries no curl and no wget, so compose cannot reach them.

known_false_probes.why_false: same binary, same reason; the worker additionally has no HTTP listener on the API port at all. Its metrics listener on VIZRA_METRICS_ADDR is the thing a real probe would reach.
known_false_probes.real_probe_exists: none reachable from inside the image today.
